_comment: Strata Stone weathering. Level 0 is the clean font; levels 1..N are built as 'Strata Stone Worn N'. chips: share of edge pixels knocked out; bumps: share of outward bumps; fault: sideways shift (px) of the upper part along a fault line, 0 = off. Damage is progressive: everything at level N is also at level N+1. alternates: variants per glyph, cycled by the calt feature. levels16: the same for Strata Pixel (16 grid, 1 px strokes), built as 'Strata Pixel Worn N'; stronger bumps because a 1 px stroke rarely allows a chip. In the game the level follows how catastrophic the latest event was (src/ui/turmoil.ts).
